newsitem.title: USA: Duff raises B.F. Goodrich ratings.
newsitem.headline: Duff raises B.F. Goodrich ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said on Monday it raised B.F. Goodrich Co senior notes and debentures to Single-A-Minus from Triple-B-Plus and upgraded the company's quarterly income preferred securities to Triple-B-Plus from Triple-B.

Duff & Phelps said the upgrade reflects improved credit quality measures, the third-quarter 1996 removal of a contingent liability regarding litigation with Westlake concerning chlor-alkali and olefins operation, and expectations that debt levels could increase again to the current 35-to-40 percent debt-to-capital range as B.F. Goodrich focuses on growth of its core business, partly through acquisitions and divestitures. (--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787)
